script_text:
Stop! Aquarius, your fixed air chart is being pushed to rewrite the rules right now.

The transiting Sun in Virgo forms a sextile to Uranus in Taurus, activating your 8th House of resources and your 4th House of foundations. Saturn in Aries squares Neptune in Pisces across your 3rd and 12th Houses, checking promises, contracts, and fears. Your sign is ruled by Saturn, so verify details before acting on inspiration.

In love, this Sun-Uranus sextile can trigger a conversation in your 7th House about emotional reciprocity; singles may meet someone unconventional, while Aquarians should avoid assumptions.

For career and money, favor a solution involving budgets, commissions, taxes, or a project at home in your 8th House. Confirm figures before signing.

Avoid vague verbal agreements, but expect an unexpected gift: a resource or supportive ally may surface. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
